source_url: https://commonvoice.mozilla.org/ (the dataset or page the recording came from)
licence_evidence_url: the page that proves the licence for THIS dataset (dataset card, LibriVox PD statement)
consent: CC0: the contributor's own public-domain dedication when donating. Own/talent recording: holder, date, scope (cloning, commercial use, AI disclosure), where the signed paper is kept (never in the repo)

labels_from_source.accent: as the source labels it, or null

readers_note: volunteer not identified; we never name or identify a volunteer reader
dsp: edge fix: strip exact-zero and sub-floor edges (78 ms lead, 39 ms tail)
voice_edges clean --no-pad: noise-only room tone removed (530 ms lead, 960 ms tail), guards kept, span samples identical
highpass 70 Hz 2 poles; one linear gain to -23 LUFS; no denoise, no gate
sha256_ref_wav: <sha256 of the final clip as cloned>
transcript: only if the source publishes it; never produced by ASR
chosen_by: the owner, by ear, date, from top 3 of <ranking path>
